long-form/2.wav.text: What is the Global Citizen Festival? Did it do something to reduce poverty? This Saturday, New York will host the Global Citizen Festival, an annual musical event with a very impressive number of stars and invested in a mission just as impressive, ending poverty in the world. The Global Citizen Festival, now in its seventh edition, will see tens of thousands of people running to Central Park's Great Lone in order not only to benefit from the artist's performance such as Janet Jackson, Cardi B, Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness of the population to the true objectives of the festival, namely to put an end to extreme poverty by 2030.

long-form/3.wav.text: The application uses Solid technology to allow people to create their own online personal data store or DPL. This can contain contact lists, task lists, a calendar, a music library, as well as other personal and professional tools. It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify were all available at the same time on a single browser. The particularity of the personal data store online is that it is entirely up to the user to decide who can access what type of information. The company calls this personal responsibility via data. According to the CEO of the company, John Bruce, the idea of Inrupt is that the company brings resources, processes and appropriate skills in order to make it solid and accessible to all.
